name: Sant Jaume dels Domenys (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with a large white scallop shell.
history: The official flag of Sant Jaume dels Domenys is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with the white scallop shell of the arms of height 3/4 of the cloth at the centre; published in the DOGC on 12 June 1995.

features.role: scallop shell of 3/4 of the height
